reviewRequired.note: C is intended,but pathogens are not limited to unicellular organisms:viruses and multicellular parasites can cause disease too. No complete definition is offered.
A is intended for hormone-secreting glands,but not all glands are endocrine:exocrine glands also exist. No valid answer covers all glands as worded.
AandDare both valid lists of endocrine/neuroendocrine structures. Kidneys inBalso have endocrine functions although not usually listed as a discrete gland. Source lacks a unique answer.
The source conflates lymphatic transport and all white cells with the adaptive third line;accept a precise immune-system explanation.
